name: What is the typical timeline for a luxury outdoor project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a luxury outdoor project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most projects take 8-12 weeks from initial design consultation through final installation, depending on scope, permitting, and material lead times. Complex pools or full backyard transformations may extend to 4-6 months.
